items.title: File Widerspruch against contribution increase
items.quote: Den Widerspruch können Sie binnen eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Musterquell Krankenkasse, Am Brunnenhof 2, 35390 Mustergießen.
items.computation: Bescheid dated Wed 18.11.2026, presumed handed to post that day. Statutory delivery fiction under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X is the 3rd day after posting (the letter itself wrongly states the 4th day). 3rd day after 18.11.2026 = 21.11.2026, which is a Saturday; by established practice (analogous to § 193 BGB) the fiction shifts to the next business day, i.e. Monday 23.11.2026. (Using the letter's own stated 4th-day rule gives 22.11.2026, a Sunday, which likewise shifts to Monday 23.11.2026 — both readings coincide.) So Bekanntgabe = 23.11.2026. The one-month Widerspruchsfrist (§ 84 SGG) starts the following day (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB) = 24.11.2026 and ends, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the day of Bekanntgabe, i.e. 23.12.2026. That day is a Wednesday, not a public holiday in NW, so no further shift applies.

items.title: First direct debit of the increased monthly contribution (Jan 2027)
items.quote: Wir buchen den Beitrag weiter zum 15. des Folgemonats ab.
items.computation: The new monthly rate of 318,46 € applies from 01.01.2027. The letter states the contribution for a given month is debited on the 15th of the following month, so the January 2027 contribution (first month at the new rate) is debited on 15.02.2027; this is a recurring monthly direct debit, not a one-off deadline.

warnings: The letter states the postal-delivery fiction as "am vierten Tag nach seiner Aufgabe zur Post", but the statutory rule under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X for such notices is the third day after posting; in this case both readings happen to land on the same calendar day (23.11.2026) because of the intervening weekend, but the discrepancy itself is worth noting and double-checking against the envelope/postmark date if precision matters.

The new contribution amount of 318,46 € is stated as already decided based on 'Ihren Einnahmen laut Steuerbescheid für 2025' without showing the prior amount or a detailed calculation, so it may be worth verifying the underlying income figures used by the Krankenkasse.
